preamble: Palatalization of the bilabial nasal [m] to the palatal nasal [ɲ] before front vowels, with loss of the labial closure. It is characteristic of Aromanian, where the change is general, so Latin mel 'honey' and mīlia 'thousands' give njari and njilji, where nj spells [ɲ]. Bantu passive and diminutive forms with m > ɲ are morphologically conditioned alternations and are not counted here.
sources: Guia, S. (2020). Palatalizarea consoanelor labiale în româna vorbită dialectală. Proceedings of the International Conference "Communication, Context, Interdisciplinarity" 6: 329–339. https://www.diacronia.ro/en/indexing/details/A32452
